intent.problem_statement: Refactor registration flow to include a landing page with CTA, and restrict Digi-check access to logged-in users only.
success_metrics: Landing page with CTA button is the entry point.
Digi-check is only accessible after login/registration.
User experience is seamless from landing to check.

constraints.performance_requirements: Fast transition from landing to registration.

architecture.state_management: SessionStorage for pending_url; Next.js App Router for navigation.

decisions.question: Post-registration navigation flow
decisions.rationale: Minimize friction; user is redirected straight to the action they intended.

decisions.question: Landing Page Input Strategy
decisions.choice: Option A (The Hook - URL Input on Landing)
decisions.rationale: Increases user investment and leads to higher conversion in the registration step.

decisions.question: Routing Architecture
decisions.rationale: Better SEO, cleaner code, and separation of marketing vs. application logic.
